KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
